messages:
maria: oncall-bot just escalated a P1 — frontend latency spike affecting sessions in eu-west1. I'm wrapping up my shift, need a quick handoff.
inc-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - FRONTEND_LATENCY - Incident #INC-4821 - triggered 2026-03-15T02:00Z - assigned to maria
maria: @alex can you take driver? main customer impact: elevated tail latency (~500-800ms) on /generate for a subset of tenants during burst windows. No DB errors so far; looks like model-host routing/backpressure.
alex: taking driver. Can you confirm comms owner? I can drive triage and mitigation but need someone to own customer updates and public status.
maria: @jordan can you be comms for the next hour? i'll DM you a short brief. Runbook: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/p1-frontend-latency — check the "eviction & routing" section.
jordan: i can take comms. i'll post initial status to #status-page and update customers. ping me here if anything changes.
sam: heads-up — my pager on my phone has been flaky since earlier. i can standby for infra actions but can't be comms primary.
alex: OK, plan: 1) confirm model host health + scheduler backlog, 2) check routing table and cache hit rates, 3) try cache warmup or fallback model if tail persists. Quick commands to start:
```
# check model host health
rgx infra/hosts | xargs -I {} curl -s http://{}/healthz
# tail scheduler logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=scheduler --tail=200
```
alex: if tail latency doesn't drop within 20m, we will trigger a canary fallback to a smaller shard and enable prefix cache warming (runbook has exact steps).
maria: noted. i'm handing over the runbook notes and recent memory dump in DM. @oncall-bot please reassign INC-4821 to alex and set comms to jordan.
oncall-bot: reassigning INC-4821 to alex. Notifying rotation calendar.
alex: small typo incoming — ignore that previous test message. all good.
jordan: drafting status now: "We are investigating increased request latency impacting session creation for eu-west1. Primary engineer (@alex) is investigating; mitigation steps under way. Next update in 15m." :writing_hand:
alex: thanks. @sam can you stand by for infra escalations? if model hosts show OOM or kern errors we'll need you to rotate the pool and coordinate reboots.
sam: standing by. if i don't respond in 5m ping me twice.
jordan: status posted to #status-page and external status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-4821
alex: takeover confirmed. maria — thanks for the quick handoff. i'll own driver and update here when we have mitigation or need escalation.
maria: thanks team, i'm signing off. :wave:
inc-bot: Incident INC-4821 updated: owner=alex, comms=jordan, state=investigating
